# Load libraries 

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```


# Import data

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
metadata_ereef <- read_csv("data/metadata/metadata_ereef.csv")
```

# Data manipulation 

```{r}
env_var <- metadata_ereef |> 
  select(-Population) |>
  scale(center =TRUE, scale =TRUE)|>
  t()

ran_var1 <- as.data.frame(matrix(rnorm(6 * 100), nrow = 6, ncol = 100))
ran_var2 <- scale(ran_var1) |> t()


```

# Export data 
```{r}
write.table(env_var, "baypass_env_metadata.txt", col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

write.table(ran_var2, "baypass_ran_metadata.txt", col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```
